raw_text: Read all files referenced by the invoking prompt's execution_context before starting. Parse phase number; if missing: ERROR: Phase number required. Load context: `node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" init phase-op "${target}"`; read STATE.md and ROADMAP.md. Target must be > current phase number. Confirm removal before proceeding. Run `node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" phase remove "${target}"`; use `--force` only if the user confirms. Commit: `node "./.claude/get-shit-done/bin/gsd-tools.cjs" commit "chore: remove phase {target} ({original-phase-name})" --files .planning/`. Don't remove completed phases (have SUMMARY.md files) without --force. Don't remove current or past phases. Don't manually renumber — use `gsd-tools phase remove` which handles all renumbering. Don't add "removed phase" notes to STATE.md — git commit is the record. Don't modify completed phase directories. Report changes.
